text: Yes, native forest was deforested on this property in 2022. Earth observation data shows 0.5 hectares of native forest loss within the 17.6-hectare asset. The change was confirmed by multiple sources: Hansen Global Forest Change detected 0.6 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2022, while the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference map confirmed forest presence in the area in 2020. The MGAP 2021 forest map identified the lost area as native forest, with no planted forest involved. The total loss exceeded the 0.5-hectare minimum event threshold, making it a verified deforestation event.
